environment.description: Same EKS 1.28 cluster. Pod deployed in namespace 'messaging' with Istio 1.20 sidecar auto-injected. Istio AuthorizationPolicy applied at mesh level with a DENY rule scoped to workloads in 'messaging' namespace: spec.rules matches source.namespace not in ['messaging'] with operation on port 8080. Additionally, a second AuthorizationPolicy in namespace 'processing' uses CUSTOM action with ext_authz provider 'opa-envoy' that validates the x-source-workload header against registered consumers. The mesh operates in STRICT mTLS mode (PeerAuthentication). Note: the EL injection still executes locally in the consumer JVM—the authorization policies govern outbound routing calls from the compromised consumer to other mesh services, limiting lateral movement post-exploitation.
